name: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade: The Graphic Adventure

locations.note: Indy and Elsa search the catacombs beneath a Venetian library for the Grail knight's tomb.
Indy finds his father held in Castle Brunwald and fights his way through its maze of corridors; Elsa steals the Grail diary.
Father and son pass through Berlin to take back the diary at the book burning, with a brief meeting with Hitler, then leave from the airport by Zeppelin or biplane.
The Grail temple in the Canyon of the Crescent Moon, placed in the Hatay of the film and modelled on Petra.

routes.name: The quest for the Grail
routes.note: In the film's order: Venice, Brunwald, Berlin, then by air to the Canyon of the Crescent Moon.
